But maybe the universe has put her here for a reason, because the handsome loner staying at the lodge turns out to be Stefan Gonzales, the tech guru at the center of the scandal. As she gains his trust to expose him, she finds herself falling in love with him. Now she must use the lessons from yoga to choose: the perfect story or the perfect man?

programme.title: Girlfriends of Christmas Past
programme.desc: This Christmas three women plot revenge on the guy who cruelly dumped them all. But will vengeance be worth risking a chance at new love?

programme.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Silberhaus children are excited for the festivities to begin. Marie and Fritz are playing in the children's room when their godfather Drosselmayer arrives and presents them with an early Christmas gift, a Nutcracker. Marie witnesses a great battle between a vast army of toy soldiers led by the Nutcracker against a terrible platoon of mice commanded by the Mouse King. Follow Marie and Fritz's journey in the Kingdom of Dolls, through the Christmas Forest, past the Almond Milk Sea, and the Palace of the Marzipans.

programme.title: The Nights Before Christmas
programme.desc: In this Christmas set horror, a pair of crazed killers have written a very special 'naughty' list of targets. You better watch out, as now they've checked it twice, all sorts of festive hell is about to break loose! When a series of murders in the run up to Christmas are found to be linked, FBI Special Agent Natalie Parker is tasked with tracking a pair of psychotic serial killers. But she soon discovers the couple are not only crazy, having met in and escaped from an asylum for the criminally insane, but have based their personas on Santa and Mrs Claus. As Christmas approaches, they slaughter their way through their special naughty list, playing a cat and mouse game with the FBI and leaving a trail of gruesome bloody bodies in their wake.

programme.title: Benji's Very Own Christmas Story
programme.desc: On a surprise visit to meet Kris Kringle, Benji and his friends are shocked to discover that he plans to take the night off on Christmas Eve!

programme.title: Christmas at the Ranch
programme.desc: When Haley Hollis returns to her family ranch, she wasn't banking on spending so much time with with ranch hand Kate - or falling for her.

programme.title: Triumph
programme.desc: Triumph is an uplifting story about overcoming ones disability. Based on a true story, this inspirational drama stars Academy Award nominee Terrence Howard (Crash), RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad) and Colton Haynes (Arrow). A determined teen who has mild cerebral palsy strives to be a wrestler on his high school's team and goes to humorous lengths to win over the heart of the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Pick of the Litter
programme.desc: Meet Patriot, Potomac, Primrose, Poppet and Phil, bred to bring independence, companionship and joy to the visually impaired. This is a dog-umentary with serious pedigree, being described as the most joyous film of the year by critics. Sure to melt your hearts we follow these pups through an intense two-year odyssey as they train to become dogs with serious responsibility. Totally pawesome!

programme.title: Office Uprising
programme.desc: Get ready for the worst work day ever in this absurdly funny zombie infestation! An underachiever (Brenton Thwaites: Pirates of the Caribbean: Salazars Revenge) working at a weapons manufacturing firm must rescue his one true love from psychotic zombie co-workers who have been weaponized by Zolt, a new energy drink. Co-starring Jane Levy (Dont Breathe) and Karan Soni (Deadpool).

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Little Miss Sunshine meets The Blind Side. Even losers can win! When an unlucky car salesman (Andy Garcia) finds himself thrown into caring for a homeless grifter (Dafne Keen) they embark on a cross country road trip to find her father. Loan sharks, side hustles and a lot of fun along the way, this car salesman soon discovers an old dog can learn new tricks.

programme.title: The Slaughter Rule
programme.desc: A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.

programme.title: Hope Gap
programme.desc: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O'Connor shine in William Nicholson's intimate portrait of a family crisis.

programme.title: Between us
programme.desc: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

programme.title: 14 Love Letters
programme.desc: After historic love letters start anonymously appearing in Kallie Sharp's mailbox, the hobby farmer searches for her secret admirer and opens herself up to love.

programme.title: Beauty and the Billionaire: Bali
programme.desc: American doctor Ivy Miller lives in Bali, working at a charitable health clinic. When a billionaire benefactor named Dylan Donnelly arrives, Ivy is less than impressed. He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan's trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan's lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he's well.

programme.title: A Very Country Christmas
programme.desc: When Country superstar Zane Gunther is looking to escape the chaos of fame, he retreats to the small town where he had fond childhood memories. There he meets a single mother, Jeanette Williams, who's trying to make the best life for her and her daughter, Quinn. With little time for herself, let alone romance, will working with Zane on the local Christmas Concert be just what Jeannette needs to open her heart to the possibility of love?

programme.title: A Man for Every Month
programme.desc: Blogger, Megan, tends to shy away from dating, but that all changes when her boss assigns her to vlog her dates for the eligible bachelor calendar. Now pushed out of her comfort zone, Megan must quickly learn the golden rules of dating.

programme.title: The Perfect Stalker
programme.desc: When Grace becomes obsessed with her neighbor she invents an imaginary stalker to help get him to protect her.

programme.title: A Friend's Obsession
programme.desc: After Megan's fiancé is killed, Lloyd follows her to win her love, but her new boyfriend stands in the way.

programme.title: California King
programme.desc: When mattress store manager Perry's childhood crush Lynette announces she's leaving town, he panics. Desperate to prove himself, he and his reckless best friend Wyatt concoct a harebrained scheme to "rescue" her younger brother from a fake kidnapping—only to accidentally pull off a real one.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

programme.title: Chimera Strain
programme.desc: A disturbed scientist freezes his children alive, while he races to cure their genetic disease.

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: When video-game enthusiast, Sarah (Isabelle Allen), is transported into her favorite game, she finds herself on an intergalactic prison, home to the most dangerous villains in the galaxy.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Two immortally linked souls transcend the boundaries of time and space, one desperately searching for the answers that will save the other, and deliver the promise of eternal life.

programme.title: Stalked by My Patient
programme.desc: When Dr. Hillary Spenser saves the life of Gregory Lipton, he becomes dangerously obsessed with her, threatening the good doctor and all those in her life.

programme.title: An Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: An Imperfect Murder is a cat and mouse thriller which will leave you guessing until the very end – staring Sienna Miller and Alec Baldwin.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former protégé to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: Pretty Cheaters, Deadly Lies
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller starring Kate Drummond. A high school senior is blackmailed into taking her cousin's college entrance exam, risking everything to keep her secret safe.

programme.title: What The Nanny Saw
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller with Revell Carpenter. When nanny Kimberly uncovers her employer's affair with a lady who later turns up dead, she dives into the couple's dark secrets, fearing she might be next.

programme.title: Secrets In The Snow
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller starring Aubrey Reynolds. Meeting the parents becomes more of an ordeal than normal when a woman is thrown into drama surrounding the death of a family member.
